During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] using the handle '''Tiny.f''' was active on the [[Cularin holonet node]] under the user ID '''tinyf111'''.<ref name="destabilization">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/livingforce/swlf20040105|text=Destabilization}}</ref> The slicer's username referenced the acronym "[[TINYF]]", a term associated with defiance of the [[Thaereian military]]'s presence in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]].<ref name="TINYF">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/livingforce/swlf20031106thaere|text=Thaere Is Not Your Friend}}</ref> Around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of [[Operation False Horizon]], Tiny.f discovered an encrypted message on an old [[Thaereian]] [[HoloNet/Legends|holonet]] node from [[Jir Tramsig]],<ref name="destabilization" /> the leader of Thaereian forces in the Cularin system,<ref name="Over Thaere">{{Wizards|url=rpga/livingforce/article.asp?x=lf/swlf20011004b_thaere&c=swlfc|text=Over Thaere}}</ref> to [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]-based Thaereian [[Navy/Legends|naval]] [[Commander/Legends|commanders]] which called for Thaereian [[Army/Legends|troops]] to counter all resistance received in the Cularin system and referenced a Thaereian endeavor to covertly drive social and economic disruption in the [[Star system/Legends|star system]]. Tiny.f decrypted Tramsig's message and shared it on a Cularin holonet node forum. This prompted heated discussion on the message board regarding the legitimacy of Tramsig's post and the implications of the purported Thaereian destabilization initiative.<ref name="destabilization" />
